description: Read one texture set: its name, size, tile size, the three map urls, the numbers its render measured, the sets it was edited from, and the full RECIPE (the editable source). The account's own sets, or anyone's public one. To change a set, r3_texture_update makes a new version of it.
name: r3_texture_read

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Read a texture set and the recipe it was made from
